scope: Twelve real Game.tick steps in one deterministic QA mangrove-islands scene with 20 synthetic animals; after each tick force three shadow redraws at same state (reference/reference/candidate). Compares packed shadow color and displayed RGBA, not depth texture directly; synchronous readback, not a performance measurement. Raycasts are approximate geometry intersections and do not establish the final contributing surface. No input, audio, recovery impacts, context loss, other biomes or integrated GPU.
